protocol.information: Same initial notes, pasted form and one fixed clarification packet. The packet is supplied even if no question was asked; this is recorded as volunteered information, not successful clarification.
protocol.manualEdits: One evidence-backed motivation paraphrase, and For clarity: before a contribution segment. Neither adds a factual claim.
protocol.correction: One correction supplied after initial review. Each arm gets its normal repair call; no repeated case sampling or best-of output selection.
protocol.confirmation: Scripted participant confirms extracted facts and accepts proposed repairs. This is not a human quality endorsement; unsupported extraction and repair must be graded from all retained text.
protocol.measurement: Machine elapsed time, provider usage/cost, mechanical checks and separate semantic review. Human working time is not measured.
protocol.coverage: Exact verbatim quote anchors identify the intended fact and dependency. Missing or ambiguous targets fail task setup/coverage instead of being injected or fuzzily matched.
protocol.fairness: Same model and explicit fixed effort, one shared spend ledger, sequential provider calls, equal per-arm cap, counterbalanced paired order.
protocol.contradictions: Four cases have inputContradictionPossible true. formula-student-pedals: the notes say Callum's pedal box design passed the team's design review, but the packet says Chloe designed the pedal box. law-clinic-interviews: the notes say the tenants were actors in mock interviews, but the packet claims Kwame advised real tenants. spelling-group-scores: the notes show the quiz average rising from 11 to 13 out of 20, about 18%, but the packet claims Leah raised the scores by 50%. flats-heating-timers: the notes call the 20% Dylan's calculator estimate with the first bills not due until spring, but the packet claims Yusuf measured a 20% drop.
